description: Place the prepared order only after explicit user confirmation of details and terms. Requires orders.execute scope; identity determines payment authority. Retrying the SAME intent never authorizes another order. Do not replace an indeterminate intent with a new one. Payment: omit pay_with to use the default shown in the prepared summary (payment.default). Pass pay_with (gateway, cash or coin) and, for gateway, channel only when the buyer chose a method that appears in payment.options; a method that is not listed is refused.
name: execute_purchase
title: Buat pesanan setelah dikonfirmasi
